meta.title: Condicionales
meta.goal: Ya combinas tiempos en condicionales mixtos (pasado → presente, etc.).

cards.title: Condicionales: qué expresa
cards.lede: Ya combinas tiempos en condicionales mixtos (pasado → presente, etc.).

rows.key: Tipo A: Causa pasada → Efecto presente
rows.value: If + past perfect, would + verbo base · If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor today.

rows.key: Tipo B: Causa presente → Efecto pasado
rows.value: If + past simple, would have + participio · If I were braver, I would have accepted the offer.
Uso de 'now', 'today', 'at the time' para indicar el tiempo de cada cláusula.
Se puede usar could / might en lugar de would para indicar posibilidad.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: If + sujet + had + V3, sujet + would + V base + now · If she had saved money, she would own a house now.
If + sujet + past simple, sujet + would have + V3 · If I spoke French, I would have translated it.
If I hadn't missed the train, I wouldn't be stuck here now. · Past perfect neg + would neg
Would you be happier now if you had taken that job? · Would + S + V base if + had + V3?

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: If I had accepted the promotion in London, I would be living there right now.
If Peter weren't so indecisive, he would have bought that property last week.
If we hadn't lost our passports, we wouldn't be waiting at the embassy today.
If I had learned to code at school, I would have a much higher salary now.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Tercer Condicional Puro (Pasado → Pasado)
columns.rule: Tanto la hipótesis como el resultado imaginario pertenecen 100% al pasado.
examples: If I had studied, I would have passed the exam last year.

columns.label: Condicional Mixto (Pasado → Presente)
columns.rule: La causa hipotética ocurrió en el pasado, pero su efecto afecta la realidad presente.
examples: If I had studied, I would have a degree now.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: If I had win the lottery last year, I would buy a yacht today.
If I had won the lottery last year, I would buy a yacht today.
lines.note: la cláusula de condición pasada requiere 'had + participio pasado' (had won)

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: No es un error gramatical; se combinan tiempos para reflejar la realidad temporal de la frase.
Si la condición es un rasgo continuo del presente, usa pasado simple en la cláusula con 'if'.
Estas palabras en la cláusula principal suelen indicar el uso de 'would + verbo base'.
Sustituyen a 'would have' para expresar capacidad o posibilidad reducida en el pasado.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: If I ___ my keys yesterday, I wouldn't be locked out of my apartment right now.
quiz.explain: Causa pasada hipotética (perder las llaves ayer) → past perfect negative ('hadn't lost').

quiz.q: If Sarah were more organized, she ___ her presentation on time last night.
quiz.explain: Condición presente/habitual (ser organizada) con resultado pasado (terminar anoche) → 'would have + V3'.

quiz.q: If we had taken the map with us, we ___ lost in the forest right now.
quiz.explain: La consecuencia actual ('right now') de una acción pasada requiere 'wouldn't be + adjetivo'.
